title: Bayesian Rational Search Engine User
abstract: arXiv:2605.24233v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A user faces a list ordered by a noisy proxy for relevance and decides whether to pay to inspect another item or stop with the best she has found. Because she does not know the page's quality, each inspection both produces a candidate and updates her beliefs about the remaining items. We show that the optimal policy is a standout rule: the user stops when her best find is sufficiently good relative to what she expects from the page, with the required margin changing with depth. The browsing dynamics collapse to a one-dimensional Markov chain, yielding the full distribution of inspection depth through a closed-form recursion. The model uncovers three reasons for stopping: trust, commit, and cut-losses, and yields testable implications. It also turns inspection depth into a learning-to-rank likelihood. Observed depth restricts the latent relevance path to a polyhedron of survival inequalities, while conversion identifies the terminal w

translated_title: 贝叶斯理性搜索引擎用户
translated_abstract: 一位用户面对一个按有噪声的相关性代理指标排序的列表，需要决定是付费检查下一条项目，还是带着她已找到的最佳结果停止。由于她不了解页面的质量，每次检查既产生一个候选结果，又更新她对剩余项目的信念。我们证明最优策略是一条“突出规则”：当用户已找到的最佳结果相对于她对页面的期望足够好时，她便会停止，所需的优势裕度随浏览深度变化。浏览动态可坍缩为一维马尔可夫链，并通过闭式递归给出检查深度的完整分布。该模型揭示了停止浏览的三种原因：信任、承诺与止损，并给出可检验的推论。它还将检查深度转化为一个用于学习排序的似然函数：观察到的深度将潜在相关性路径约束在一个由生存不等式构成的多面体中，而转化行为则识别最终的w……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文将搜索引擎用户的付费浏览行为建模为贝叶斯最优停止问题，证明最优策略是随深度变化的“突出规则”，通过一维马尔可夫链闭式刻画检查深度的完整分布，揭示信任、承诺与止损三种停止原因，并将观察到的检查深度转化为学习排序的似然函数。
en_tdlr: The paper models a search engine user's paid browsing as a Bayesian optimal stopping problem, proves the optimal policy is a depth-dependent "standout rule," collapses browsing dynamics into a one-dimensional Markov chain with a closed-form inspection-depth distribution, identifies three stopping reasons (trust, commit, and cut losses), and turns observed inspection depth into a learning-to-rank likelihood.
